title: Imshab Shabe Matame Hussainast
body:
Imshab Shabe Matame Hussainast
Alam Ho Mader Fughan Wo Shainast
In Noore Hudaye Alamainast
In Shamso Zohe Mashra Khainast
<<DIVIDER>>
In Badr Duld Jaye Khoufa Khainasth
Im Shaba Jahan Hussain Hussainasth
Ahle Do Jahan Nuwa Hussainasth
Dardo Fughan Nuwa Hussainasth
<<DIVIDER>>
Chun Matamian Nuwa Hussainasth
So Zandaz Jahan Nuwa Hussainasth
Hurane Jin Nuwa Hussainasth
Bar Khake Tapan Nuwa Hussainasth
<<DIVIDER>>
Chun Matamiya Nuwa Hussainasth
